prerequisites: Proficiency in vector and matrix calculus
Differential and integral calculus in one variable

learning_outcomes.text: Students possess advanced knowledge of mathematical techniques for modeling and solving their scientific problems.
Students confidently apply the previously learned basic techniques of analysis within the framework of advanced mathematical procedures.
Students model problems in their area of application using mathematical methods.

assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written exam. The duration and scope of the exam are as per the currently valid study regulations.
